description: Portfolio personal: sitio web estatico construido con Astro 6 + TypeScript y gestionado con pnpm.

features.name: agent-harness-setup
features.description: Arnes de agentes y tooling base: 7 agentes de OpenCode en .opencode/agents/ (leader, spec_author, implementer, reviewer, commiter, secure-auditer, skill-generator), AGENTS.md, opencode.json, docs/, progress/, specs/ y CHECKPOINTS.md. Tooling: ESLint + Prettier + Vitest + astro check, scripts pnpm lint/check/test/build/validate y smoke test del index con Astro Container API.

features.name: hero-section
features.description: First UI increment from the Stitch "Full Chromatic Glass" design: global design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, animations) in src/styles/, fonts bundled from Fontsource (Newsreader + Plus Jakarta Sans), the hero section (headline, tagline, CTA buttons, CSS atmospheric blooms) and a dependency-free clipboard enhancement for the hero secondary CTA that copies the contact email and shows the design toast. Excludes the WebGL shader background, floating nav, remaining sections, footer and reuse of the toast outside the hero copy interaction.

features.name: projects-section
features.description: Second increment from the Stitch "Full Chromatic Glass" design: the projects section on the home page (anchor id="projects") rendered from a Zod-validated Markdown content collection `projects` (unique UUID id, title, description, technologies[], coverPath validated with the schema-context image() helper, coverAlt, websiteUrl, optional githubUrl, unique priority, featured). Includes four example entries seeded from the mockup (Synapse as featured, Aether Cloud, Kortex Editor, Vanguard CLI), raster WebP placeholder covers in src/content/projects/covers/ optimized through Astro's image pipeline (sharp added as a dependency), pure sorting/uniqueness helpers and tests tracing R<n>. Excludes nav, tech-stack/about/contact sections, footer, WebGL shader, project detail pages and Markdown body rendering.

features.name: fix-featured-project-card-layout
features.description: Bugfix for the done projects-section feature: the featured project card breaks at >=1024px. In src/components/ProjectCard.astro the >=1024px grid assigns .project-card__meta to grid-column 1/span 6 and .project-card__cover to grid-column 7/span 6 without pinning rows, so the DOM-ordered cover occupies row 1 and the meta is auto-placed into row 2, leaving the cover alone and a large empty gap. Expected: meta (left) and cover (right) side by side in the same row at >=1024px, stacked cover-first below that breakpoint, with a regression test for the responsive placement.

features.name: technologies-section
features.description: Third UI increment from the Stitch "Full Chromatic Glass" design: the tech stack section on the home page (anchor id="tech-stack") rendered from a Zod-validated JSON content collection `technologies` (fields: id, category, iconUrl, name) with svgl SVG logos vendored in public/icons/logos/ and referenced by local iconUrl paths. Follows the mockup's tech-stack bento glass section including its four categories and closing quote (specs/projects-section/references/projects-section.html lines 1199-1733; digest in specs/hero-section/references/design-notes.md). Excludes nav, about/contact sections, footer, WebGL shader and client-side JavaScript.

features.name: ci-github-action
features.description: GitHub Actions CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) named "CI" that runs on pushes to all branches and on pull requests targeting main. Installs dependencies with pnpm using dependency caching, then runs typecheck (astro check), lint (eslint), format check (prettier --check, non-mutating) and tests (vitest). Excludes deployment, release automation, build/artifact publishing and any change to application code.

features.name: fix-hero-headline-whitespace
features.description: Bugfix exposed by the new CI on PR #7: after main bumped to Astro 7 (astro ^7.2.8, PR #5), the compiler trims the whitespace between the hero headline text and the accent span, so HeroSection renders "intersección de<span>ingeniería" and tests/hero.test.ts > renders_verbatim_hero_texts fails, a real visual regression ("deingeniería"). Emit the space explicitly in src/components/HeroSection.astro so the strict verbatim contract holds under the upgraded compiler. Also sync feat/create-github-actions with main: merge origin/main, resolve the feature_list.json and progress/history.md conflicts (technologies-section keeps id 5, ci-github-action becomes id 6 and this fix takes id 7, updating the affected references), reinstall dependencies with Astro 7 and leave pnpm validate green so PR #7 turns green and becomes mergeable. Excludes CI workflow changes: .github/workflows/ci.yml and tests/ci-workflow.test.ts already pass.

features.name: contact-section
features.description: Fourth UI increment from the Stitch "Full Chromatic Glass" design: the contact section on the home page (anchor id="contact") with the mockup header ("Contacto y Colaboración" eyebrow, "Construyamos algo increíble juntos" headline and intro), a left column with a click-to-copy direct email card (carlosolcina23@gmail.com, reusing src/scripts/clipboard.ts and the BaseLayout toast) and a "Redes y Perfiles" card rendered from a new Zod-validated JSON content collection `profiles` with exactly id, title and url per entry (seeded with realistic example entries from the mockup to be replaced by the human), and a right-column contact form (name, email and message fields plus "Enviar Mensaje" button) shipped as presentation-only UI: no submission handler and no success feedback, so a future feature can wire the message logic. Extracts the shared contact email into a single site constant imported by both HeroSection and ContactSection. Omits the mockup's Cal.com meeting-booking card entirely and excludes the experience/about section (the human has no experience data), nav, footer, WebGL shader and new dependencies. NOTE: re-implementation after a git mishap lost the tracked-file modifications; the spec and the untracked implementation files survived.
